title: BlackboardGap.v1
description: A GAP entry: a named piece of missing information that blocks the analysis, plus why it matters. Gaps are the convergence currency — the swarm converges when open gaps reach zero (see BlackboardConvergenceReport). status moves open -> closed when a later observation/source resolves it. A gap asserts a hole, not a fact, so it is not truth-bearing; the matching BlackboardEntry row (kind=gap) carries serves_truth=false.

entry_id.description: id of the BlackboardEntry (kind=gap) this body belongs to

blackboard_id.description: the blackboard this gap belongs to

missing.description: the specific missing information that blocks the analysis

why_it_matters.description: why closing this gap matters to the task (so the swarm prioritizes correctly)

status.description: open = still blocking; closed = resolved by a later observation/source (convergence currency)
